headline: A 2014 law names a U.S. Forest Service building in Nebo, North Carolina, the "Jason Crisp Forest Service Building."
what_it_does: The law gives an official name to the Forest Service facility that houses the Grandfather Ranger District at 109 Lawing Drive in Nebo, North Carolina. The new name is "Jason Crisp Forest Service Building." It does not change how the building is used, who works there, or what services it provides.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on August 8, 2014.
